image.description: The container registry path for the image that defines this Machine.

env.description: Environment variables to inject into the Machine at runtime.

services.description: Network service definitions for exposing this Machine externally.

checks.description: Named health check definitions. Keys are check names; values are check configuration objects.

schedule.description: Run this Machine on a recurring schedule. Valid values are hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly.

auto_destroy.description: When true, the Machine is automatically destroyed after it exits.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for internal routing and configuration.
